en.purpose: To calculate and assess the histologic grade for the Figo grading for endometrioid adenocarcinoma.
en.misuse: Not to be used for grading other histological subtypes of endometrial cancer, such as serous or clear cell carcinomas.

other_details.en: An assessment tool used to determine the histologic grade of endometrioid adenocarcinoma based on the proportion of solid growth and the presence of severe nuclear atypia.
